TURKISH PREPARATION EDUCATION AND
EXAMINATION DIRECTIVE

GENERAL PROVISIONS and PURPOSE:
Article 1- Turkish proficiency exams for postgraduate programs (master's and doctoral) in GTU Institutes
of Natural Sciences and Social Sciences, which are entitled to enroll candidates residing abroad and
holding Turkish citizenship, candidates from Turkish Republi cs and Communities, and foreign national
students, are conducted according to the academic calendar determined by the Senate. Students who
succeed in this proficiency exam, graduates of universities providing education in Turkish domestically
and abroad, a s well as students holding Turkish Language Center (TLC) certificates, may directly
commence postgraduate education in programs related to their own fields of study.
Article 2- The aim is to provide Turkish language education programs for students who are entitled to
register in the Turkish Preparation Education at the Institute but are deemed insufficient in Turkish
language proficiency, in order to equip them with the necessar y skills and abilities to follow Turkish
education programs.
DEFINITION:
Article 3- In this directive, "language" refers to Turkish, "GTU" refers to Gebze Technical University,
"Institutes" refer to the Institutes of Natural Sciences and Social Sciences, and "TPD" refers to the Turkish
Preparation Department.
SCOPE:
Article 4- This directive covers how Turkish Preparation Education will be organized in compliance with
the GTU Postgraduate Education and Instruction Regulation, as well as how exams and evaluations will
be conducted.
PROFICIENCY EXAMINATION:
Article 5 - Candidates who have been admitted to a master's and doctoral program are subject to the
Turkish Proficiency Examination. In order to be successful in this exam, they must achieve at least 60%
of the total score. Those who fail to achieve this or do not take the exam are considered unsuccessful.
TURKISH PREPARATION:
Article 6- Students who fail the pr oficiency exam enroll in the TPD for Turkish Preparation education,
which lasts for a maximum of 1 (one) academic year, in order to attain sufficient proficiency in Turkish
language. Registration procedures at the Institute are separately carried out by the Rectorate Student
Affairs Directorate.
Students undergoing Turkish Preparation education must participate in one of the profic iency exams
organized by the TPD, held on 2 (two) separate dates, within 1 (one) academic year from the registration
date. Students who fail to succeed within this period lose their right to register for the main discipline they
applied for.
Article 7- The duration of education in preparation classes and exam dates organized by the TPD are
conducted in accordance with the academic calendar determined by the GTU Senate.

Article 8- The lists of students who successfully complete Turkish Preparation education are collectively
reported to the Instit utes by the TPD . These students register for the main discipline they applied for at
the beginning of the first semester following their preparation education.
Article 9- This directive shall enter into force as of the date of its acceptance by the GTU Senate.
Article 10- The provisions of this Directive shall be implemented by the TPD Presidency.
